title: FAQ: What happens when AI gets something wrong?
caption:
"What happens when the AI gets something wrong?"

Unclear items are flagged, and products, locations, quantities and units are checked before anything counts. Nothing changes until a person approves, and if something slips through, the fix is a new entry, never an edit, so the history stays clean.

AI drafts, people approve. Book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.
